entries.decision: Decorate only an actual VideoDisplayService V2.0 XSD INVALID ListViewCapabilitiesResponse in which more than one PDF-documented capability member is serialized although the exact XSD models ViewID, ViewName and ViewType as one xs:choice.
guards: official VideoDisplayService V2.0 profile only

entries.decision: Decorate only an actual official VideoRecordingService V2.0 XSD INVALID GetVideoRecordingStateResponse where State is combined with PDF-documented ordinary fields such as AlarmArchiveFillLevel or OperationErrorMessage but the exact V2.0 XSD places all members in one xs:choice.
guards: official VideoRecordingService V2.0 profile only
